main:1.text: It has been six months after Amicia and Hugo successfully defeated Vitalis Bénévent and the Inquisition. All has been peaceful and the two have traveled the countryside in search of a new home alongside their mother, Béatrice, and their friend, Lucas.

main:2.text: Amicia, Hugo, Béatrice, and Lucas arrive at the Red City, where the Order has provided them with a house. A yearly event is taking place in the city called the Saint John's Fair. Amicia and Hugo explore the fair together before heading to their new house. It is above the marketplace and has a phoenix weathervane.

main:3.text: Béatrice sends Amicia and Lucas to get nightshade, which she and Vaudin need to calm Hugo's tremors. Amicia and Lucas cross the rainy Red City. Amicia is furious with Vaudin and feels he has been treating Hugo like an animal, but Lucas insists she needs to give him more time, and he is the most competent in his domain.

main:4.text: Two days have passed, and Hugo hasn't been getting better. Amicia is furious and Lucas has to stop her from barging into Hugo's room. Vaudin says a Carrier reaching the final threshold is a very rare event, and Hugo must be isolated. He mentions that the order has special buildings for such events. Beatrice tries to soften the news that Hugo is condemned; no potion can save him at this point.

main:5.text: Amicia, Hugo, Lucas, Beatrice, and Joseph travel through the waterways to Marseille. There are bodies and debris from the Red City all throughout the water. Hugo, hurt by the destruction he has caused, vents to Amicia about feeling unheard. Beatrice tries to appeal to Amicia, but she protests that going to the Order's headquarters in Marseille—locking Hugo up—is not the solution. The boat is caught in debris.

main:6.text: Hugo and Amicia wander the county of Provence together. Hugo worries for Beatrice and Lucas, as well as Amicia's head wound from Arnaud. She reassures him they will be alright. They come across a camp of pilgrims traveling to Rome. A woman directs them to their leader, Perreux, a man who knows the region well.

main:7.text: Amicia wakes up against a tree. Hugo eagerly informs her that Arnaud saved her and has promised to take them to the island from his dreams: La Cuna. Amicia protests Arnaud's presence, but cannot fight due to her concussion and passes out. Two days pass in a haze with Arnaud taking care of her and Hugo.

main:8.text: Amicia, Hugo, Sophia, and Arnaud sail the Rascasse to La Cuna. During the journey, Amicia has the opportunity to converse with her companions and explore the ship. They dock at La Cuna's port. Sophia advises Amicia to "be nice", given that the island is under the Count's law. Sophia stays on board to fix a few things while Amicia, Hugo, and Arnaud go ashore to explore.

main:9.text: Amicia and Hugo wake up in the palace. They have been given new clothes. They leave to explore the island and search for the reason Hugo dreamt of it. They travel through the palace grounds and leave for the village. They are intercepted by Sophia just outside the palace walls. She knows Arnaud is in jail, and inquires into the situation. Amicia explains that he betrayed them.

main:10.text: At the base of the mountain, Amicia hides the cult disguises the trio wore in Sanctuary. They plan to search for the round tower, and attempt to lift Hugo's spirits, as he is still dismayed about his dream. They agree to return to the map in the theater ruins. Looking at the map, they do not see a round tower, but they find a chapel, which could lead to the Capella where Aelia was taken.

main:11.text: Amicia, Hugo, and Sophia exit the ruins and return to the main area of the island—only to find that it is swarming with rats. They use torches and Sophia's prism to pass through them, passing dead islanders along the way. They find survivors, but they are quickly swallowed by the rats. They find a cart with a brazier, but its wheels are blocked by a beam.

main:12.text: Hugo, Amicia, and Sophia plan to leave La Cuna. On their way to the harbor, a soldier arrives, recognizing them as the guests of the Count. He tries to bring them to the palace, where they have guests; Beatrice and Lucas have followed them to La Cuna. Sophia agrees to leave and prepare the boat while they go retrieve Lucas and Beatrice. The soldiers are fighting to keep the rats at bay.

main:13.text: Amicia pleads with Hugo to speak with her because he is in a sort of mental dissociation and won't even look at her. Lucas urges her to get up so they can go to the harbor and get to safety, but she is distraught and grief stricken. Lucas says he will lead the way. He gets the de Rune siblings to their feet and guides them forward.

main:14.text: The Rascasse sails peacefully. Lucas speaks with Amicia briefly, then she has the opportunity to walk around the ship and catch up with her companions. Hugo worries that he is 'different,' but he is eager to go to the mountains. Sophia asks about their plans and Amicia tells her about the de Rune mountain home. Arnaud is still passed out. Lucas talks with Amicia about how she is feeling.

main:15.text: After Sophia's shipwreck, Amicia wakes up on the beach and sees Arnaud bandaging her wound. While he does that, she screams in pain. Arnaud then gives her a potion and helps her sit up. Amicia becomes worried about Hugo and Arnaud apologizes, saying that he failed to save him because he was stuck. Amicia is eager to save Hugo. Arnaud says that Sophia and Lucas have gone ahead, looking for horses.

main:17.page: Legacy of the de Rune Family
main:17.text: A year has passed since Hugo died. Amicia now lives in her mother's mountain home and is determined to track the Macula. She goes outside and Sophia shows up.
